recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-22116; any future concern about the external ex-revenue-center CodeSystem should be handled through THO/UTG rather than core source.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Financial Management request to add National Uniform Billing Committee attribution to the example Revenue Center CodeSystem used by Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit; the Jira resolution comment says the codes in question were removed from the example codeset to resolve the issue.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed commit was found for FHIR-22116. Commit 2a7b55d5f4 initially added NUBC attribution to source/claim/codesystem-ex-revenue-center.xml on the issue creation date; commit f7b4d814e2 later removed the potentially infringing revenue-center concepts and replaced them with generic examples, and commit 5c0494aacf removed the former core CodeSystem source during UTG/THO migration.
additional_context: FHIR-23003 is the applied same-family issue for removing potentially infringing ex-revenue-center examples and is already represented on the combined branch by 46dde41f4b493844f884877b51ccc992dffe85e5. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit active, while source/claim/valueset-ex-revenue-center.xml composes the external terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem. The current THO ex-revenue-center CodeSystem contains only generic concepts 0010 Vision Clinic, 0011 Dental Clinic, and 1001 Emergency under THO licensing.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding NUBC attribution to the core ValueSet wrapper would be stale because the NUBC-derived examples were removed and the authoritative CodeSystem concepts are no longer in the FHIR core source checkout.

related_jiras.note: Applied companion issue that formalized removing potentially infringing ex-revenue-center examples; it was not republished because combined branch commit 46dde41f4b493844f884877b51ccc992dffe85e5 already audits it.
